dimensions.assessment: Affects employers providing equity compensation and employees receiving restricted stock units.
dimensions.evidence: allow employees to share in the future success of their companies through a mechanism that may not otherwise be available to rank-and-file workers.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies overtime calculation rules for certain forms of employee stock compensation.
dimensions.evidence: exempt any value or income derived from employer-provided grants or rights provided pursuant to a stock option... from the determination of an employee's regular rate

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue effects are stated or implied in the source.
Amends a single subsection of the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to include restricted stock units.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7(e)(8) of the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 (29 U.S.C. 207(e)(8)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change with national reach taking effect 90 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall take effect on the date that is 90 days after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific estimates of the number of affected workers or companies are not provided.
Exact fiscal or economic impact data are not mentioned.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill clarifies that restricted stock units qualify for the existing Fair Labor Standards Act overtime exemption, affecting employers and employees utilizing equity compensation.
